body:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] Rolling out runtime v2.3.7 -> canary pool (10%) on eu-west-1. Roll ID: r-2026-03-15-1895. Triggered by @marcus.

lena (eng-oncall): seeing increased 95p latency in canary within 2 minutes of rollout. metrics dashboard -> https://rwd/metrics/r-2026-03-15-1895 (open)

marcus (eng-runtime): confirmed. Kernel selector falling back to generic-kernel on several nodes. logs: `kernel.cc: fallback to kernel_generic for model=gpt-lite seq=2048`. Could be a mismatch with the new kernel affinity heuristics.

sgt-reed (eng-sre): paging oncall. This looks like a runtime regression causing throughput drop + queue build-up. Can we pause rollout? 

lena (eng-oncall): @deploy-bot please pause rollout.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Rollout r-2026-03-15-1895 paused by lena (eng-oncall). Canary traffic frozen.

emily (product): are there any customer-facing errors? any 5xxs?

nora-cs: CS notes a couple of customers reported slow replies, not errors. Most are in eu-west. No escalations yet but monitoring chatter.

marcus (eng-runtime): digging into batcher logs. Observed continuous-batching backpressure: `batcher: queue_size=128, max_batch=64, avg_wait_ms=180`. That wait time is killing tail latency. kernel fallback causes slower per-token throughput which amplifies batching delay.

sgt-reed (eng-sre): hypothesis: a kernel affinity tweak in v2.3.7 triggers fallback on older GPU images, causing slower kernels. Quick mitigation options: 1) force kernel affinity to previous policy, 2) kill-switch feature-flag to revert runtime behavior, 3) rollback release.

marcus (eng-runtime): I can push a kill-switch flip to disable the new affinity heuristic in the canary. Doing that first since it's lowest impact. Command: ```sh
# flip feature flag for roll r-2026-03-15-1895
curl -X POST https://rwd/flags/r-2026-03-15-1895/flip -d '{"affinity_v2":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```

lena (eng-oncall): @marcus go ahead. Also capture metrics before/after.

infra-bot: [AUDIT] Flag flip requested by marcus at 2026-03-15T09:12:40Z. Target: canary pool.

marcus (eng-runtime): flipped flag. Observing immediate drop in kernel fallbacks. batcher queue halved within 30s.

lena (eng-oncall): tail latency 95p decreased from 920ms -> 320ms across canary. Partial recovery but still above baseline (~180ms).

sgt-reed (eng-sre): good. Can we safely resume rollout after verification? Or do we prefer rollback to previous release?

marcus (eng-runtime): I recommend aborting this rollout and rolling back the control-plane version to v2.3.6 for now. The flag mitigates, but the affinity heuristic needs a patch. Rollback steps: `deploy rollback r-2026-03-15-1895 --target=canary` then re-run tests.

lena (eng-oncall): initiate rollback. @deploy-bot execute.

deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK START] Rolling back r-2026-03-15-1895 on canary -> restore v2.3.6.

infra-bot: [AUDIT] Rollback started by lena at 2026-03-15T09:18:02Z.

marcus (eng-runtime): monitoring after rollback. Kernel selector restored to previous defaults. batcher queue normalizing.

nora-cs: CS update: two customers saw degraded latency during the 6-minute window; both on eu-west. Logged for follow-up.

emily (product): flagging for SLA check. Noting customer impact minimal but track follow-ups.

lena (eng-oncall): handoff to daytime oncall @marcus in 20m for post-rollback verification and a follow-up issue. I'll create an incident ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-sre.

marcus (eng-runtime): creating PR to revert affinity heuristics and add canary-only unit tests for kernel selection. Also adding a regression alert for `batcher.avg_wait_ms > 100` and `kernel.fallback.count > 5/min` in eu-west canary.

sgt-reed (eng-sre): postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (affinity heuristic regressing older GPU images), mitigation (flag flip + rollback), customer impact, action items (tests + feature gate), owners. I'll start the doc.

lena (eng-oncall): thanks team. Handoff: @marcus you'll own the incident follow-up and the patch; @sgt-reed you'll own postmortem. I'll close the page once daytime confirms metrics stable.

marcus (eng-runtime): acknowledged. Quick note: add a small canary quota for kernel experiments next time (max 1% traffic) to limit blast radius.

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY COMPLETE] Rollback r-2026-03-15-1895 finished on canary at 2026-03-15T09:23:25Z.

lena (eng-oncall): last check: 95p latency back to baseline ~190ms across canary, CPU/GPU utilization stable. I'll mark this as mitigated and file incident ticket INC-2026-1895.

emily (product): adding note for customer comms team: proactive email if we see any late reports.

nora-cs: will prepare short message template.

sgt-reed (eng-sre): starting incident draft: https://rwd/incidents/INC-2026-1895/draft

lena (eng-oncall): handoff completed. Leaving open for owners to add docs. If anything regresses, re-open and ping @oncall. :white_check_mark:
